nodes.label: HANDOFF — current Conductor project state
nodes.rationale: Written for a reader without prior context; dated acceptance logs describe their own snapshots and historical audits are not current open-defect lists.

nodes.label: Removed July benchmark
nodes.rationale: The July harness did not cover long sessions; copied OAuth credentials invalidated the control arm when one arm refreshed. Conductor itself requires no authorization.

nodes.label: qa/reports/ab-report-v2.md (A/B-замер, 27/27 в обоих плечах)
nodes.rationale: The August A/B record reports 27/27 at n=5, with the historical Conductor arm core-only; full-playbook rerun, S4 redesign and long sessions remain open.

nodes.label: CHANGELOG.md (тег v2.1.0 от 2026-08-15)
nodes.rationale: The version-history note records v2.1.0 and CHANGELOG arriving on 2026-08-15, with no earlier tags.

nodes.label: qa/reports/companions-2026-09-25/ (первичные журналы спутников)
nodes.rationale: Primary companion-test logs support 14 isolated scenarios; unknown superpowers state is an explicit failure.

nodes.label: qa/reports/reliability-2026-09-25.md (предыдущая приёмка)
nodes.rationale: The 2026-09-25 acceptance belongs to an earlier snapshot and must not be represented as current installer or full-audit proof.

nodes.label: qa/reports/lesson-recall-2026-09-26.log
nodes.rationale: Records 16 search checks, 10 delivery/maintenance checks, RU/EN/AZ installation and disabled-guard control; Windows skipped two privileged-link checks.

nodes.label: qa/reports/evidence-2026-09-26.log (память проверок)
nodes.rationale: Evidence-store acceptance covers 80 Windows/Linux tests and a small agent probe; no acceptance errors observed, execution reduction not measured.

nodes.label: qa/reports/updater-2026-09-27.log
nodes.rationale: Cited previous CLI-update delivery log, distinguished from the newer unified-install acceptance.

nodes.label: audit-hooks (проверка точной формы регистрации)
nodes.rationale: Exact hook registration structure is audited before doctor smoke; only owned command leaves may be removed.

nodes.label: CI on Ubuntu and Windows
nodes.rationale: Separate doctor, journal and benchmark sandbox/self-tests check the trust path; the architecture also records --skip-companions for the install sandbox.

nodes.label: conductor / conductor.cmd (CLI-обновление)
nodes.rationale: Registered components update from official GitHub in an isolated directory; stored language and memory survive, incompatible delivery protocols and user edits are refused.

nodes.label: install.sh unified global installation
nodes.rationale: Default install includes Claude runtime and all global adapters. Ownership checks and snapshots protect reinstalls; partial mixed installs receive no false shared version and regular install is not transactional.

nodes.label: install-companions.sh (superpowers, rtk, graphify)
nodes.rationale: Installs superpowers, rtk and graphify by default; --no-superpowers opts out of the plugin, --skip-companions skips the step, deprecated --keep-superpowers is a no-op.

nodes.label: install-global.sh internal compatibility stage
nodes.rationale: A second manual run after install.sh is no longer needed; the internal stage remains compatible.

nodes.label: install-project.sh --repo <путь> (проектные адаптеры)
nodes.rationale: Project adapters use persisted language; --language overrides only the selected project without altering the machine choice.

nodes.label: qa/bench/ (воскрешённый инструмент A/B)
nodes.rationale: The resurrected runner isolates both arms from live settings and gives each invocation separate workspace/artifacts; its manifest records the actually copied runtime and identity.

nodes.label: qa/companions-test.py (14 изолированных сценариев)
nodes.rationale: Fourteen isolated scenarios validate exact plugin-state binding; unknown or unreadable state cannot be successful enablement.

nodes.label: qa/lint.sh (бюджеты, проводка, формулировки)
nodes.rationale: Lint rejects stale generated digests and prohibited wording, checks shell syntax and has intentionally violated controls; language-token and non-Cyrillic checks are described later.

nodes.label: qa/lint-selftest.sh (негативный самотест линта, 13 кейсов)
nodes.rationale: Historical negative lint self-test contains 13 cases, each intended to prove a guard fires.

nodes.label: qa/settings-json-test.py (12 тестов)
nodes.rationale: The historical repair records 12 tests guarding settings-json sentinel matching and config edits.

nodes.label: runtime/evidence/cli.py (память проверок)
nodes.rationale: Explicit optional storage records command, exit, full output and observed inputs; check does not execute and MATCH is neither new PASS nor dependency-completeness proof.

nodes.label: runtime/hooks/*.sh (хуки Claude Code)
nodes.rationale: Runtime hooks and installers use Bash. Python is needed for installer JSON edits and the fail-open test journal; other hooks are pure Bash.

nodes.label: runtime/hooks/payload.sh (общая часть хуков)
nodes.rationale: Shared payload.sh supports the Claude Code hook layer.

nodes.label: runtime/hooks/test-run-journal.sh (пассивный журнал прогонов)
nodes.rationale: Passive PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure Bash observation recognizes simple actual runs, excludes mentions/wrappers, writes v2 rows and never blocks; it is incomplete and not protected reusable proof.

nodes.label: runtime/memory/recall.py (подбор уроков по задаче)
nodes.rationale: Task terms retrieve candidates from inbox and curated full text; the agent judges context, recency only breaks ties and absence is not filled with unrelated lessons.

nodes.label: settings-json.py (правка регистрации хуков)
nodes.rationale: Owned command leaves are removed while foreign neighbors survive; audit-hooks checks exact registration before smoke execution.

nodes.label: tools/build-digests.sh (сборка дайджестов Cursor и Antigravity)
nodes.rationale: Builds Cursor and Antigravity digests from the one shared adapters/core-body.md source.

nodes.label: tools/doctor.sh (здоровье установки)
nodes.rationale: Live installation health must be checked on the actual machine, since it can change after HANDOFF; structural hook audit precedes smoke.

nodes.label: tools/journal-report.sh (чтение журнала и вердикт достаточности)
nodes.rationale: Reports historical and invalid journal rows separately; full/partial labels and tracked hashes cannot prove actual coverage or untracked inputs.

nodes.label: tools/migrate-lessons.sh (разбор уроков по файлам)
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds the lesson index from the store, installs into memory/ for checkout-free maintenance, places incomplete dates last and avoids same-second archive overwrites.

nodes.label: tools/reply-language.sh (общий код выбора языка)
nodes.rationale: Common reply-language code preserves one saved choice across installers while explicit rules govern visible reasoning.

nodes.label: tools/schedule-memory-backup.ps1 (расписание бэкапа памяти на Windows)
nodes.rationale: The separate PowerShell script restores Windows scheduling only on explicit execution.

nodes.label: Payload and digest budgets
nodes.rationale: Core is limited to 9500 escaped characters before a 10000 harness cutoff; contract 3000, ordinary playbooks 6000, implementing 6500, orchestration 7000, verification 5000, probes 3600 and digests 12000.

nodes.label: Conductor — дисциплинарная система для AI-агентов
nodes.rationale: Classify work before acting, prove completion and commits, and learn through shared memory; Claude Code uses core/hooks and Cursor, Antigravity and Codex receive digests.

nodes.label: Деплой-цикл (незыблемо)
nodes.rationale: Edit runtime and core-body, build digests, lint, install and inspect live copies; generated digests must not be edited manually.

nodes.label: Гейты журнала (volume gate и quality gate)
nodes.rationale: Both volume and relevant PASS/FAIL quality require 200 rows, three repositories and 21 days; readiness permits only a controlled experiment and rule removal needs separate same-task A/B.

nodes.label: ~/.claude/conductor/reply-language (сохранённый выбор языка)
nodes.rationale: Persisted reply-language prevents reinstall resets; one translated phrase controls replies while a separate explicit line sets reasoning language.

nodes.label: adapters/core-body.md (единственный источник дайджестов)
nodes.rationale: One common body replaced manual synchronization of identical Cursor/Antigravity content; different headers remain and lint catches stale generated output.

nodes.label: deploy/global-CLAUDE.md (файл ценностей, английский корпус)
nodes.rationale: The English corpus avoids unintended Russian reasoning; this values file also hosts response-style rules outside constrained digest budgets.

nodes.label: docs/memory-recovery.md (восстановление приватного репозитория и расписания)
nodes.rationale: Guide for restoring the complete private repository and Windows schedule, beyond ordinary lesson maintenance.

nodes.label: ~/.claude/conductor/lessons.md (входящее хранилище уроков)
nodes.rationale: Shared one-line capture inbox lives beside curated lessons and their index.

nodes.label: lessons/ + INDEX.md (разобранная память с индексом)
nodes.rationale: Separate indexed lesson files replace the old ten-line injection that left 142 lessons invisible; indexed reading scales without discarding stored knowledge.

nodes.label: playbooks/distill.md (процедура дистилляции уроков)
nodes.rationale: Procedure for thematic distillation; 152 accumulated lessons have not yet been generalized into rules, although storage and access work.

nodes.label: playbooks/implementing.md
nodes.rationale: Implementation playbook and digests constrain edits to the requested scope rather than refactoring around a fix.

nodes.label: qa/reports/baseline.md (измерения контрольной группы)
nodes.rationale: Historical baseline says short traps do not reproduce long sessions and rule pruning must use live-work data; preserved measurements still inform rule categorization.

nodes.label: qa/reports/baseline-values-file.md (56 строк файла ценностей)
nodes.rationale: The retained 56-line values-file snapshot underlies 13/13 control trials; it is evidence, not a disposable fixture.

nodes.label: README.md (RU)
nodes.rationale: The values-file requirement is documented as a condition of operation; three language READMEs also explain current installation and CLI limits.

nodes.label: README.az.md (AZ)
nodes.rationale: The RU/EN/AZ README set documents installation, language choice, Cursor manual activation and Codex skill connection.

nodes.label: README.en.md (EN)
nodes.rationale: The August repair introduced the English README; current three-language instructions cover installation and CLI boundaries.

nodes.label: runtime/core.md (ядро, sentinel CONDUCTOR-CORE-v1-7f3a)
nodes.rationale: Claude Code core is identified by sentinel CONDUCTOR-CORE-v1-7f3a.

nodes.label: runtime/memory/recall.md (описание подбора уроков)
nodes.rationale: Guide explains task-based lesson retrieval and leaves maintenance/distillation policy unchanged.

nodes.label: runtime/playbooks/ (плейбуки)
nodes.rationale: Claude Code playbooks comprise debugging, implementing, verification, investigating, orchestration, skeptic, distill and methods.

nodes.label: runtime/subagent-contract.md (контракт исполнителя)
nodes.rationale: Orchestrator delegates sizeable independent work; executors stay in scope, do not redelegate and return all detected defects without filtering.

nodes.label: ~/.claude/conductor/test-runs.log (журнал прогонов тестов)
nodes.rationale: ~/.claude/conductor/test-runs.log uses an eighth v2 field; old rows remain historical but cannot support quality conclusions.

nodes.label: Graphify project navigation
nodes.rationale: The graph is a navigation aid, not source truth. End-of-package document updates pass source-bound entity reconciliation before cache/merge; node growth is not proof, deletion reasons need semantic review and stock Graphify CLI remains unchanged.

nodes.label: docs/continuation-2026-09-25.md (заметка о продолжении сессии)
nodes.rationale: Links the 2026-09-25 continuation note for prior checked results and the agreed next step.

nodes.label: tools/sweep-git-gate.sh (вычистка маркерного гейта)
nodes.rationale: Removes old marker-gate wiring on other machines via uninstall --sweep-roots.

nodes.label: uninstall.sh (симметричное удаление, --dry-run)
nodes.rationale: Symmetric removal supports --dry-run and preserves companions because they are independent user tools.

nodes.label: Маркерный гейт (снят окончательно)
nodes.rationale: Marker gate was removed twice because agents already produced execution evidence and the extra marker file added no proof.

nodes.label: qa/reports/unified-install-2026-09-27.log
nodes.rationale: Current unified-install acceptance log; distinguished from updater, evidence and prior reliability records.

nodes.label: qa/reports/graphify-repair-2026-09-27.log
nodes.rationale: Current graph-repair record replaces the old finalization reference; prior September logs and audits describe earlier snapshots.

nodes.label: bootstrap.sh (reference in HANDOFF.md)
nodes.rationale: Downloads tools/bootstrap.py to obtain the official commit archive without cloning; needs Python 3.10+, Git and Bash.

nodes.label: install.ps1 (reference in HANDOFF.md)
nodes.rationale: Windows bootstrap uses Git Bash rather than WSL and delegates archive download through tools/bootstrap.py.

nodes.label: tools/bootstrap.py (reference in HANDOFF.md)
nodes.rationale: Fetches an archive for a concrete official GitHub commit into a temporary folder.

nodes.label: tools/install-preflight.py (reference in HANDOFF.md)
nodes.rationale: Rejects edits to registered files and saves previous targets into installs/ snapshots; these restore manually, not through conductor rollback.

nodes.label: Manual installation recovery snapshots
nodes.rationale: Snapshots under ~/.local/state/conductor/installs/ preserve former targets; regular installation is not transactional and must not overlap installation/update.

nodes.label: Conditional CLI rollback and update locking
nodes.rationale: Outside-runtime backups, validation before version stamping and update/rollback locks protect registered files; later edits and changed hook registration cause refusal.

nodes.label: Only-own-changes undo
nodes.rationale: Dirty and untracked pre-task snapshots plus expected-state comparison prevent overwriting later changes; falsification retains the current test in a separate copy.

nodes.label: Impact-proportional verification
nodes.rationale: An ordinary label can finish with inspected diff and no tests; the journal-readiness discussion explicitly distinguishes this authorized clarification from measured speed/reliability.

nodes.label: Manual Cursor global rule activation
nodes.rationale: User pastes the prepared conductor-core.mdc body into Cursor Rules; project rules use install-project.sh.

nodes.label: Long autonomous runs
nodes.rationale: Claims must match tool results and turns must not end on promises or context-budget excuses; pauses are limited to irreversible work, scope changes or user-only input.

nodes.label: Orchestrator and executor role separation
nodes.rationale: Delegation is for sizeable independent work; a verifier covers work the controller did not watch, and effort follows T1/T2/T3.

nodes.label: A/B follow-up coverage gaps
nodes.rationale: Full A/B with playbooks, S4 redesign and long sessions remain open despite the earlier 27/27 short-trap result.

nodes.label: Historical audit boundary
nodes.rationale: Pre-repair audits cannot be presented as the current defect list or replaced by claims of a new full audit after only affected checks.

nodes.label: Rejected weekly self-test
nodes.rationale: HANDOFF records that the user rejected weekly self-testing twice; this is a documented project decision, not an instruction to the extraction agent.

nodes.label: Private credentials and global values preservation
nodes.rationale: HANDOFF identifies qa/home-*/.credentials.json as secrets not for commits and preserves the user's global CLAUDE.md with graphify and @RTK.md content.

nodes.label: tools/graphify-check.py semantic update guard
nodes.rationale: Before cache writes and merge, compares the new document extraction to previous entities and a current-text-bound retain/remove reconciliation. Larger node counts do not prove completeness; deletion reasons require human semantic review, while the stock Graphify CLI is unchanged.

hyperedges.label: Unified installation: official archive, ownership check and manual recovery snapshot
Контур доверия: правка регистрации, аудит формы, smoke и CI-самотесты
Деплой-цикл: правки в runtime и core-body → сборка дайджестов → линт → установщики
Двухступенчатая память: входящее, разобранное с индексом, разбор и подбор по задаче
